_doc: Infantry looks (read by src/render/people/soldier_figure.gd and squad_model.gd). Our own designs in
the spirit of the core book's people (Union troops, corpro security, pirates, frontier militia);
the models are assets/people/soldier.glb, built by tools/blender/soldier_mh.py.
factions: which helmet and armor set, and colors by material role (uniform, armor, trim, visor).
A unit's own paint (the crew/company scheme, MechPaint format) overrides: primary -> uniform,
secondary -> armor, glow -> visor, markings -> trim.
by_side: the faction when the unit doesn't say. launcher_every: every Nth man carries a launcher.
